arrangement.notes: Sample-based arrangement with texture bed and one-shot hits, vocal focused, cinematic rise and fall energy profile.

sound_intent.description: Emotional phonk arrangement with cinematic energy fluctuations focusing on vocal expressiveness supported by textured sample beds and impactful one-shot hits.

routing_intent.drums: Send all transient-based samples processed with transient shaper to drum bus
routing_intent.bass: Low frequency samples routed through sub-bass bus
routing_intent.chords: Chopped and layered samples routed through texture bed bus
routing_intent.melody: Sliced melodic samples routed through melody bus with reverb
routing_intent.vocal: Vocal chops routed through dedicated vocal bus with compression and delays
routing_intent.fx: Effects routed through fx bus with automation on filters

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation with sample slicing technique
track_roles.bass: Low-end support through sub-bass sample layers
track_roles.chords: Harmonic texture via sliced and layered samples
track_roles.melody: Supporting melodic fragments from chopped samples
track_roles.vocal: Primary focus with vocal chops and time-stretched samples

designer_intent.goal: Create an emotional vocal-led phonk arrangement with cinematic dynamics, emphasizing sample-based texture beds and one-shot hits using sample slicing techniques.

presetor_intent.goal: Design presets suitable for granular and transient sample manipulation matching the phonk emotional mood.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns using sample slicing and transient shaping techniques with dynamic variations to support emotional and cinematic energy.

bass_generator.brief: Create low-end bass lines derived from classical phonk sample slices with smooth transitions and complementing the vocal focus.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop chord layers using chopped and looped samples that provide harmonic support without overshadowing vocals.

melody_generator.brief: Compose subtle melody fragments using one-shot hit samples and sliced textures to enrich arrangement atmosphere.

ai_designer.brief: Integrate vocal and instrumental sample layers with time-stretching and chopping to enhance emotional impact and cinematic feel.

presetor.brief: Provide sound presets for granular synthesis, transient shaping, and time-stretching tailored to sample-based phonk arrangements.

songgps.brief: Arrange sections and energy profile to create cinematic rise and fall matching emotional vocal focus with sample-based instrumentation.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Process unprocessed channel audio maintaining clarity of vocal chops and sample textures ensuring balanced cinematic dynamics.
